name: Overlord Saurfang
guide_text: Most of the benefit from this hero power is giving 1/1 or 2/2 to every minion you buy in the early game. The hero power scales a bit too slow to play into, it just serves as an enabler to shop buff demons.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for at most 3 gold. A bit too slow to play into, it's just a bit of tempo.
